newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein steady in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein steady in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were generally steady in late trading on Tuesday, with declines in Malaysia dampening sentiment, traders said.
They said palm olein was quoted at 1,460-70 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening. Crude palm oil was last done at 1,271 rupiah/kg in the North Sumatran city of Medan.
"The market was fairly stable, with buying interest remaining moderate," one trader said. "Sharp declines in Malaysia caused some buyers to take a wait-and-see attitude."
The traders said export prices remained attractive, while supply was ample.

Data from Belawan Port showed that the MT Tirta Karsa will leave on Wednesday for Semarang with 2,000 tonnes of palm olein. The MT Oriental Iris will leave on Wednesday for Madras, India with 4,500 tonnes of crude palm oil.
